description: End-of-turn gate (mirrors the Stop hook in .claude/settings.json)

hooks.command: CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" bash "$HOME/.claude/hooks/verify-turn.sh" '*.go,go.mod,go.sum,.golangci.yml::golangci-lint run ./...' 'frontend/*::npm --prefix frontend run typecheck' 'frontend/*::npm --prefix frontend run lint'
